question: Is the reported Testbox `gradlew help` run, together with green exact-head Android CI, sufficient real-setup proof for these production dependency updates, or should the contributor provide a real exact-head Android build or resolution transcript?
rationale: Repository policy makes real behavior proof a merge gate for external non-docs PRs, while the current live run does not directly exercise the changed artifact compile path; the Android owner must explicitly accept or raise that proof boundary.

options.title: Require exact-head build proof
options.body: Ask for a Testbox Android debug build or focused dependency-resolution transcript that visibly resolves and compiles both updated AndroidX libraries before merge.

options.title: Accept current evidence
options.body: Treat the real Testbox configuration run plus successful exact-head Android build and test CI as sufficient for this version-only maintenance change.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head build proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a Testbox Android debug build or focused dependency-resolution transcript that visibly resolves and compiles both updated AndroidX libraries before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current catalog baseline and reviewed the immediately preceding Android dependency refresh, making them the strongest available owner for the proof threshold.
